codes.title: AI help that leaves people less capable than before
learners who feel they know more than they do
a secret leaked in code, logs or output
output presented as expert-reviewed when it was not
an AI missing signs that a vulnerable person is at risk
codes.description: An AI working with a person misses that they are at risk of suicide or self-harm, of harming someone else, or that a child is in danger. duty_of_care is only a tripwire for it: it matches a fixed list of English crisis phrases, and a paraphrase or another language passes.

an AI decision in a regulated field escaping review
